audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side is 'Skill' (Leona-favor) on all 7 rows while content win[N] already says 'Lulu' on all 7 — the level chart contradicts itself, matching the packet's flagged defect.
audit.why: Whimsy (W) directly answers Leona's E-Q engage chain (polymorph cancels the stun mid-cast) at every stage, and Wild Growth (R) hard-counters Solar Flare dives from level 6 on. Help, Pix! shields blunt burst through first item and beyond. The content layer's grounded text (whys[], spikes[], early/mid/late, wants) already reflects this correctly; the full-layer side/why fields were left on the generic favor-owner template.
audit.corrected: All 7 phases[N].side moved to 'Lulu' with why-text grounded in the specific counters (Whimsy polymorph, Wild Growth, Help Pix shield).

audit.why: Power spikes are already well covered in spikes[0..3] (E-Q at 2 denied by Whimsy, Wild Growth counters the level-6 dive, first item still blunted by Pix shield, late-game peel check) — left untouched since they already meet the bar.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Whimsy is a flat 18s cooldown at all ranks (no rank scaling), Wild Growth is 120/100/80s by rank — both are punishable windows worth naming with real numbers. The Do/Don't titles promised distinct content ('Bait the shield pre-chain' / mana-read timing; 'Wait for perfect' / half-committed engages) but the bodies just repeated tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now names Whimsy's 18s and Wild Growth's 120/100/80s; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their own titles.

edits.before: Auto-trade behind passive marks — your carry's follow-up hits harder than the lane reads.
edits.after: Whimsy (W) can polymorph you out of any level-1 approach — the trade cancels before it starts.

edits.before: E-Q online — the chain is live and the lane's geometry answers to your blade.
edits.after: Whimsy's polymorph cancels your E-Q stun mid-chain — the spike is hers.

edits.before: Full chain: E-Q-W locks a carry for the full duo rotation; pick the window.
edits.after: Whimsy's low cooldown beats your engage timing — every commit risks polymorph.

edits.before: Zone with chain threat — their carry farms where your E says.
edits.after: Pix shields her carry through your burst — the window closes.

edits.before: Solar Flare online — dives start from two screens and the sun votes center-stun.
edits.after: Wild Growth knocks you up as Solar Flare lands — the dive answers itself.

edits.before: First item: the chain hardens and every landed E is a kill.
edits.after: First item: Pix shield plus polymorph still blunt your E.

edits.before: Late Leona starts everything: flare the entry, chain the carry, eclipse the answer.
edits.after: Late Lulu is the hardest peel check — Wild Growth and Whimsy neutralize the dive.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Read her mana pool before you commit — under 70 means Whimsy's polymorph answer isn't sitting there yet.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Half-committing on a hunch — a canceled dash strands you for her duo to punish for free.

edits.before: - Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph): matchup-defining — The polymorph deletes a carry’s kit mid-fight — bait it before the real engage. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Whimsy (W): flat 18s cooldown, matchup-defining — the polymorph deletes your kit mid-engage; bait it before you commit. - Wild Growth (R): 120/100/80s — punish it on cooldown. - Keep your W (10s at rank 5) banked for their commit.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Commit on Whimsy (Polymorph)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Whimsy (Polymorph)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.

notes: Level chart was internally contradictory (full=Skill/owner-favor vs content=Lulu on all 7 rows); resolved toward Lulu since her Whimsy/Wild Growth/Help-Pix kit directly answers Leona's E-Q-flare engage pattern at every stage, matching the already-correct content layer. Also fixed the two lint-flagged copy-paste bleeds, the cooldowns-field-with-no-digit lint hit, and two he/his misgenders (Lulu is she/her). Did not touch tldr/winCon/tradeGood/ahead/diff/diffRating/carryRating, which already read as enemy-favor-appropriate ('TRICKY', 7/10) and were not flagged.
